title: Delek Logistics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Delek Logistics reported net income of $28.9 million or $0.54 per unit, and adjusted EBITDA of $143.5 million Nearing completion of the integrated sour gas processing, treating, and handling solution at the Libby Gas Complex DDG achieved record crude oil gathered volumes, reflecting strong commercial execution across the crude gathering platform Strong year-to-date operational performance supports reiterating 2026 EBITDA guidance of $520 million to $560 million.
